annotations.annotation_text: Satirical and biographical presence of Jonathan Swift (swift): Dean of St. Patrick's Cathedral, his dual lovers Stella and Vanessa (mirroring Issy), and his ferocious political satires.

annotations.annotation_text: The Book of Kells manuscript tradition (initial): Joyce equates the text of Finnegans Wake and the Hen's letter to the labyrinthine Celtic interlacing and enigmatic Latin glosses of the 8th-century Gospel book.
sources: Trinity College Dublin: The Book of Kells Online. https://digitalcollections.tcd.ie/concern/works/hm50tr726
